entities.summary: Bahrain is a sovereign nation in West Asia, Asia. Its capital is Manama. Official languages include Arabic. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 1.5 million. Area: 778 km². Comprehensive index for Bahrain covering Dilmun civilisation, Tylos (Hellenistic), Sassanid Bahrain, early Islam (one of first to convert), Qarmatian state, Portuguese fort (1521), Safavid and Omani periods, Al Khalifa dynasty (1783), British protectorate, oil discovery 1932 (first in Gulf), independence 1971, Shia-Sunni tensions, 2011 Arab Spring uprising, and post-oil economic diversification.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Bahrain's conversion to Islam in 632 CE was one of the first major conversions, and its strategic location has made it a hub for trade and cultural exchange between East and West. The country's oil discovery in 1932 had significant economic consequences, leading to post-oil diversification efforts.
